description: This source file defines command-line tools for managing a launchd agent, including commands to install, uninstall, and check the status of the agent. It includes helper functions for writing and removing property list files for launchd.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping for 'service' with subcommands for install, uninstall, and status management.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Command to install the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Command to remove the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Command to check the status of the launch agent.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file with specified executable.

methods.name: removePlist
methods.description: Removes the launch agent plist file from the system.
